Spec.title: Exsanguinate Reap Late Maps Large Cluster

PathOfBuilding.Notes:
^x70FF70^7Build Pros and Cons:
Pros --------------------------------------------- S-tier mapping, exceptional clear Scales well as a Physical Skill Freeze is insanely good for safety Fast Reap has higher damage upside if you are willing to boss swap gems and push an extra button Very high damage ceiling, 100-400m dps with investment If you DONT want to use Reap, you can skip it entirely and still boss after a certain investment level
Cons --------------------------------------------- Gem swapping for bossing (if you don't care about bossing, ignore this) Reap requires additional sockets to acquire Blood charges with a second copy of Reap Reap requires an extra button Reap has a large life cost
Leveling --------------------------------------------- Leveling from 1-31 will be Rolling Magma with Fire Trap for additional single target. Or level with whatever you prefer. We'll be transitioning to ^x7070FFPower Siphon^7 ^x7070FFLocus Mines^7 at level 31 as soon as we acquire ^x70FF70^x7070FFCharged Mines^7^7.
Off-hand gems --------------------------------------------- Level ^xE05030Exsanguinate^7 in every offhand socket you have. You will want to corrupt them for a level 21 the moment you can, as every gem level is an important power jump. If you remember to do this early you won't have to wait as long later. ^xFFFF77Quality on the gem doesn't matter^7 as we are scaling the hit and not the DoT, don't feel obligated to quality them before corrupting for 21.
^xE05030Reap^7, however, ^xFFFF77we DO want quality^7 for as the additional damage per blood charge is substantial.
Vendor Search Strings --------------------------------------------- Movement speed boots + BBB / GGG / GGB + gem levels "b-b-b|g-g-b|g-[gb]-g|b-g-g|nne|rint|ll g|Earn"
Pre-Mine Gem Progression --------------------------------------------- Level 4: Buy ^x7070FFRolling Magma^7 + ^x7070FFElemental Proliferation^7 after Tidal Island. Buy ^x7070FFFlame Wall^7. Shoot your Magma balls through the flame wall to get additional flat fire dmg. Level 8: Get an added damage support for whichever links you are able to find, either ^x70FF70Added Cold Damage^7 or ^x7070FFAdded Lightning Damage^7, then once you kill Brutus grab ^x7070FFCombustion^7 from vendor Level 12: Pick up ^x70FF70Fire Trap^7 for single target. Link it with ^x70FF70Trap and Mine Damage^7 as soon as you complete Yeena's quest in A2
Act 2: -------------------------------------------- Your links at this point should be ^x7070FFRolling Magma^7 + ^x7070FFElemental Proliferation^7 + ^x7070FFCombustion^7 for clear and ^x70FF70Fire Trap^7 + ^x70FF70Trap and Mine Damage^7 + ^x70FF70Swift Assembly^7
Bandits --------------------------------------------- I personally will be taking the 8% movement speed buff from Kraityn, but there isn't a wrong choice here in my opinion. If you'd like to be tankier, take +40 life from Oak. If you find gearing up resistances more difficult, Alira is still a fine choice. Choose the one most likely to make your campaign experience more enjoyable. If you are a new player, I'd recommend taking Oak and the +40 life.
--------------------------------------------- ^xD02090Transition to Power Siphon Locus Mines at level 31 when you acquire Charged Mines^7 ---------------------------------------------
Act 4: --------------------------------------------- Make sure you grab^x70FF70 Grace^7 and equip one from here on out. You'll feel too squishy as you make progress into late campaign without it. Periodically you'll want to fish for better ^x70FF70EVASION^7 and/or ^x7070FFENERGY SHIELD^7 bases as you can off the ground, prioritizing your Chest Piece. This will keep you comfortably alive during the remainder of the campaign.
Flat damage from ^x70FF70^7Wrath^7^7 will be important.
^xFFFF77UPGRADE YOUR WEAPON REGULARLY FOR POWER SIPHON TO FEEL GOOD ^7 Look for: - Flat Lightning Damage - Any other Flat Damage - Crit Multi - Spell Damage - Accuracy becomes noticeable around the middle of the campaign
^xAF6025Doedre's Tenure^7 is amazing and will be cheaper this league
White / Early Maps -------------------------------------------- 1) Fix your flasks, they are probably terrible. You probably want ^xE05030Ignite^7 immunity from a flask as I find this the most annoying damaging ailment. Get a ^x70FF70Jade^7 flask, this is crucially important, and ideally find one more flask with Increased Evasion During Effect. 2) Look for better bases. The gear you had in campaign is almost certainly really bad. T1/T2 bases have a lot of Evasion/ES since they reworked them. 3) Wrath essence a decent wand so you can progress, or grab one off trade 4) Zeal essence a good belt. Crystal's are awesome until you can find a Stygian Vise
^xE05030Endurance Charges^7 ------------------------------------------- These are a really excellent defensive layer and will be important. Get them from either an ^xE05030Enduring Composure^7 small cluster (probably what I will do) or from the ^xE05030Endurance Charge implicit^7 on chests. ^xE05030 Enduring Cry^7 is also an option but I personally hate additional buttons. Swift Killer will ensure that Enduring Composure keeps your charges up all the time, even on an evasion base.
^xFFFF77ASCENDENCY ORDER^7^7 ------------------------------------------- 1. One Step Ahead 2. Swift Killer 3. Escape Artist 4. Polymath -OR- Spellbreaker. If not suppress capped through gear I would recommend Spellbreaker then decide if you want the extra damage later. For Uber bossing Spellbreaker is insanely good.
IMPORTANT: Once deal with freeze/stun I will almost certainly respec One Step Ahead --> Spellbreaker -OR- Polymath, depending on which one you took in step 4. This is because Spellbreaker is the best defensive layer in Uber fights by a lot, its a full 10% more suppress which brings us up to 66% if we're using the +3% suppress mastery. This makes Uber fights much easier. If you are just mapping then keeping One Step Ahead is fine. Choose what fits your playstyle best.
Possible uniques to wear ---------------------------------------------------------- ^xAF6025Kintsugi^7 is amazing defensively ^xAF6025Restless Ward^7 is common and can be found with good corruptions for reasonably cheap
^x8888FFCritical Strike Chance^7 ------------------------------------------- Crit will be crucially important as it will gate your ability to Freeze and deal damage. I wouldn't transition over to ^xE05030Exsanguinate^7 unless you have Pob'd that you will be getting ^xFFFF77at least 70% crit chance^7 or you just won't be freezing enough. Early on take ^x8888FFWinter's Embrace^7 to make this more comfy. There are excellent Critical Strike medium clusters available for cheap to help, and you can take or annoint really strong Crit nodes like ^xADAA47High Voltage^7, bench or get gear with ^xFFFF77Increased Critical Strike Chance for Spells^7 (shield / caster weapons), ^x8888FFDiamond flasks^7 for conditional crit chance, Hatred Watcher's eye mods with base critical strike chance, ^x70FF70Assassin's Mark^7, and so on.
If you are having a hard time crit capping, use ^xAF6025Hrimsorrow^7 gloves and ^x8888FFIncreased Critical Strikes^7 support to ease the transition.
^x8888FFSupport Gem Choices^7 ---------------------------------------------------------- -Cold Penetration is an excellent option and doesn't have the throw delay that Trap and Mine imposes -Chain/Awakened Chain are great for clear. You might want the Chaining Range wheel (Trick Shot), but I don't personally find it necessary -Prioritize Crit Capping over more Crit Multi-- if you are low on crit chance you'll get more reliable freeze with Increased Critical Strikes
^x8888FFWays to get 2% CDR for the 0.198s mine detonation breakpoint^7 ^x8888FF^xC8C8C8----------------------------------------------------------^7^7 -2% CDR on Abyss Jewel -CDR on boot implicit -Generic Gem Levels will boost the CDR enough that you won't need it elsewhere (higher budget) -Enhance is great as it also gives Mine Detonation Speed
^xFFFF77IMPORTANT^7^7^7 ^xD02090Transitioning from Power Siphon to Exsanguinate^7 ----------------------------------------------------------
DISCLAIMER: I've run this exact transition 3 times now and it's been smooth each time. The nerfs to Power Siphon might make it more attractive to switch earlier. Keep this in mind.
Before transitioning you want to have acquired: - a 5-Link minimum - at minimum level 18 Exsanguinate, ideally 20 or 21. gem levels are a massive amount of damage for spells. Quality doesnt matter - Ideally the correct spell modifiers on gear (+1 gem on weapon, +1 gem or high spell dmg on shield, spell crit chance) - ^xAF6025Kikazaru^7 -OR- enough life regen that you don't kill yourself (250-300+) - 100% Physical Conversion to Cold. ^xAF6025Hrimsorrow^7 is great for this. Other options (more expensive) are Watcher's Eye, Betrayal gloves, glove implicit, and 40% from the Cold mastery. If you don't convert your damage to elemental Exsanguinate will do very little damage.
^xAF6025Heatshiver^7 is nice but might be expensive, not required.
MAKE SURE YOU POB THIS TRANSITION FIRST. It's not a straight forward swap since you are going from Attack based to Spell based and you don't want to drop from 100% -> 50% crit strike chance with exsanguinate because you are trying to make it work with attack based gear that doesn't help out a spell.
^xFFFF77IMPORTANT^7 ^xD02090Skill Tree Transition to Exsanguinate ^7---------------------------------------------------------- You need Freeze Duration in order for Freeze to be an effective damage mitigation layer, particularly when you get to late maps. I've allocated^7 ^x7070FFWinter's Embrace^7 and Physical Conversion as part of the transition to Exsanguinate becuase ^xFFFF77YOU WANT^7 100% conversion to Cold for Cold damage to be effective. At lower damage levels, particularly right when you transition, you will want Freeze Duration.
^x8888FFFREEZE^7 - ^xFFFF77IMPORTANT^7 ------------------------------------------- Freeze is a critical thing to get right here or it will feel like dogshit to play. Freeze duration is calculated based on the size of the hit relative to the target's ailment threshhold, and as long as you are critting you will get Freezes guaranteed. You need a 0.3s Freeze for it not to be discarded, however you can get Freeze Duration from the tree (^x8888FFWinter's Embrace^7 and ^x8888FFElemental Focus^7^7) or from cluster jewels. If you aren't reliably freezing mobs path up to ^x7070FFWinter's Embrace^7 and take the whole wheel.
For example, to get the minimum 0.3s freeze on a mob you have to deal 5% of its health pool in a single hit. With 100% increased freeze duration (or ailment duration), you only have to deal 2.5% of its health pool to get the 0.3s freeze which is enough to proc Heatshiver for the next hit,
^xFFFF77 ^xFFFF77
